functions.study: (slug, studyId) => with(collection(slug), c => c && find(c.folders, s => s.id == studyId))
functions.fileItem: (f, thumbnail) => ({ id: f.id, itemType: 'file', label: f.title, seconds: f.mediaType == 'image' ? settings.imageSeconds : 0, downloadUrl: f.url, thumbnail })
functions.playFile: (f, lesson) => ({ type: 'file', id: f.id, title: f.title, mediaType: f.mediaType, url: f.url, thumbnail: lesson.image })
functions.lessonActions: (lesson) => map(groupConsecutive(lesson.files, f => baseName(f.title) != f.title ? baseName(f.title) : null), g => ({ id: g.items[0].id + '-action', itemType: 'action', label: len(g.items) > 1 && g.key ? g.key : g.items[0].title, actionType: 'play', children: map(g.items, f => fileItem(f, lesson.image)) }))

routes.browse: map(filter(datasets.catalog.collections, c => len(c.folders) > 0), c => ({ type: 'folder', id: slugify(c.name), title: c.name, path: '/' + slugify(c.name) }))
c ? map(c.folders, s => ({ type: 'folder', id: s.id, title: s.name, path: path + '/' + s.id, thumbnail: s.image })) : []
s ? map(s.lessons, l => ({ type: 'folder', id: l.id, title: l.name, path: path + '/' + l.id, thumbnail: l.image, isLeaf: true })) : []
routes.playlist: s ? flatMap(s.lessons, l => map(l.files, f => playFile(f, l))) : null
routes.instructions: s ? { name: s.name, items: [{ id: 'main', itemType: 'section', label: 'Content', children: map(s.lessons, l => ({ id: l.id, itemType: 'action', label: l.name, actionType: 'play', children: map(l.files, f => fileItem(f, l.image)) })) }] } : null

routes.browse: l ? map(l.files, f => ({ type: 'file', id: f.id, title: f.title, url: f.url, mediaType: f.mediaType })) : []
routes.playlist: l ? map(l.files, f => playFile(f, l)) : null
routes.instructions: l ? { name: l.name, items: [{ id: 'main', itemType: 'section', label: l.name, children: lessonActions(l) }] } : null
